<div class="fl-module-content fl-node-content">
<h2 class="fl-heading">
<span class="fl-heading-text">WHAT THEY'RE SAYING</span>
</h2>
</div>
</div>
<div class="fl-module fl-module-content-slider fl-node-5bfeaeef0b6b1 fl-animation fl-fade-in" data-animation-delay="0.5" data-node="5bfeaeef0b6b1">
<div class="fl-module-content fl-node-content">
<div class="fl-content-slider">
<div class="bx-wrapper" style="max-width: 100%; margin: 0px auto;"><div aria-live="polite" class="bx-viewport" style="width: 100%; overflow: hidden; position: relative; height: 902px;"><div class="fl-content-slider-wrapper fl-content-slider-loaded" style="width: auto; position: relative;">
<div aria-hidden="false" class="fl-slide fl-slide-0 fl-slide-text-left" style="float: none; list-style: none; position: absolute; width: 690px; z-index: 50; display: block;">
<div class="fl-slide-mobile-photo"><img alt="" class="fl-slide-mobile-photo-img wp-image-6217" data-pin-description="Home" sizes="(max-width: 300px) 100vw, 300px" src="https://redefiningmom.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/11/Heather-Farris-1.png" srcset="https://redefiningmom.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/11/Heather-Farris-1.png 300w, https://redefiningmom.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/11/Heather-Farris-1-150x150.png 150w"/></div> <div class="fl-slide-foreground clearfix">
<div class="fl-slide-content-wrap"><div class="fl-slide-content"><h3 class="fl-slide-title">Heather Farris</h3><div class="fl-slide-text"><div>I have never owned my own business, but have always had the desire to do so. When I found Monica's website it was like I had hit the jackpot. She has things logical and laid them out in a way that anyone can understand.</div>
<div></div>
<div>She gives detailed instruction and tips on how to navigate this online world. Her honesty about products and services is refreshing in this crowded online space. I'm so beyond happy to have found Redefining Mom and Pin Practical.</div>
<div></div>
<div>I'm now running a successful Pinterest Management Company thanks to Monica's advice!</div>
<div><strong>- Heather Farris, Pinterest Manager</strong></div>
</div></div></div><div class="fl-slide-photo-wrap"><div class="fl-slide-photo"><img alt="" class="fl-slide-photo-img wp-image-6217" data-pin-description="Home" sizes="(max-width: 300px) 100vw, 300px" src="https://redefiningmom.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/11/Heather-Farris-1.png" srcset="https://redefiningmom.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/11/Heather-Farris-1.png 300w, https://redefiningmom.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/11/Heather-Farris-1-150x150.png 150w"/></div></div> </div>
</div>
<div aria-hidden="true" class="fl-slide fl-slide-1 fl-slide-text-right" style="float: none; list-style: none; position: absolute; width: 690px; z-index: 0; display: none;">
<div class="fl-slide-mobile-photo"><img alt="" class="fl-slide-mobile-photo-img wp-image-6218" data-pin-description="Home" sizes="(max-width: 300px) 100vw, 300px" src="https://redefiningmom.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/11/tia-mac.png" srcset="https://redefiningmom.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/11/tia-mac.png 300w, https://redefiningmom.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/11/tia-mac-150x150.png 150w"/></div> <div class="fl-slide-foreground clearfix">
<div class="fl-slide-content-wrap"><div class="fl-slide-content"><h3 class="fl-slide-title">Tia Mac</h3><div class="fl-slide-text"><p>I missed my daughter's first steps. I was so happy, but sad inside because I wasn't there to witness it. In that moment, I realized I don't want to miss anymore firsts. Thanks to Monica, I have a clear plan as to moving forward turning my blog into a business. Thank you so much Monica. You're truly the best!</p>
<p><strong>- Tia Mac, Blogger</strong></p>
